children: New Delhi, Oct. 18 -- The board of directors of Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has declared raising funds through the rights issue. The small-cap took a decision in this regard at the board meeting on Saturday, declaring that the offer size would not exceed Rs.160 crore. The company board also approved the Draft Letter of Offer. The small-cap company said the terms and conditions of the rights issue will be determined and communicated later.

The small-cap stock under Rs.50 made an announcement about the rights issue through an exchange filing, saying, "We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Kellton Tech Solutions Limited ("the Company") at its meeting held today i.e. Saturday, October 17, 2026 has considered and, inter alia, approved Issue of Equity Shares of the Company of face value of Re.

1/- each (the "Equity Shares") for an amount up to and not exceeding Rs. 160 Crores (Rupees One Hundred and Sixty Crores Only) by way of Rights Issue to the eligible Shareholders of the Company as on the Record Date (to be determined and notified subsequently, and such issue, the "Rights Issue"), in accordance with applicable laws, including the Companies Act, 2013, as amended, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 (the "SEBI ICDR Regulations"), as amended, subject to such regulatory and statutory approvals, as may be relevant under the applicable laws."

Regarding other details of the Kellton Tech Solutions rights issue, the small-cap company said, "The Board of Directors have also approved the Draft Letter of Offer. Further, the Board of Directors will, inter alia, decide the terms and conditions of the Rights Issue, including but not limited to the determination of the issue price, rights entitlement ratio, record date, timing of the Rights Issue and terms of payment and other related matters."

This means the company has decided the size of the Kelltton Tech Solutions rights issue won't exceed Rs.160 crore. The rest of the information, such as the rights issue record date, subscription date, entitlement ratio and eligibility, and the purpose of the issue, will be decided and communicated later.

As the tech stock had already announced the board meeting agenda for the rights issue to raise funds, shares of the small-cap stock under Rs.50 witnessed strong buying interest on Friday. Kellton Tech Solutions' share price finished around 3% higher at Rs.12.47 per share on the NSE on Friday. The small-cap stock finished on NSE with a market cap of around Rs.660 crore and a PE ratio of around 7.3. The stock is one of the beaten-down stocks available on Dalal Street. Its 52-week high is Rs.23.80, and the 52-week low is Rs.11.80.
